title: Default Gamemode for NeoForge
description: Unofficial port of Alfakynz's mod that lets you change the default world gamemode (survival, hardcore, creative, spectator
body:
Unofficial port of the original Fabric [Default Gamemode](https://modrinth.com/mod/default-gamemode) by Alfakynz.

# 🔄 Default Gamemode 🎮

This mod lets you change the default world gamemode (survival, hardcore, creative, spectator) when creating a new world. It won’t change the gamemode of an existing world!

## ✨ Features

*   Changes the default gamemode when creating a new world
*   Changes the default difficulty when creating a new world
*   Supports all gamemodes: Survival, Hardcore, Creative, and Spectator
*   Includes settings to configure which gamemode and difficulty to set as default (with [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/9s6osm5g))

## 🔄 Versions

*   Minecraft 1.21.1
*   NeoForge >= 21.1.227
